features.name: norm_v1_v2_distance
features.description: Measures the absolute difference between the standardized values of V1 and V2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-invariant distance metric between two key continuous descriptors, improving neighborhood geometry for KNN.

features.name: heavy_atom_count_proxy
features.description: Aggregates multiple integer count features to estimate overall molecular size or complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality of sparse count features into a single dense magnitude, helping KNN group instances of similar scale.

features.name: hydrophobicity_polarity_ratio
features.description: Calculates the ratio of V12 (shifted to be positive) to V15.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a normalized feature that captures relative proportions rather than absolute magnitudes, which is more robust for Euclidean distance calculations.

features.name: molecular_complexity_index
features.description: Combines V8 and V30 using a square root transformation to dampen extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the scale of large continuous variables, preventing them from dominating the KNN distance calculation.

features.name: prototype_distance_origin
features.description: Computes the Euclidean distance to the origin for a subset of key continuous features (V1, V2, V13, V15).
features.expected_model_benefit: Serves as an unsupervised prototype distance, allowing KNN to quickly stratify instances based on their overall magnitude in a subspace.

features.name: prototype_distance_mean
features.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to the global training mean vector for V1, V2, and V15.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a centralized prototype metric, helping the model distinguish between typical and anomalous instances in the feature space.

features.name: fragment_density
features.description: Normalizes the sum of specific fragment counts (V16, V23, V34) by a continuous size descriptor (V8).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a density metric that is invariant to overall scale differences, improving similarity matching for molecules of different sizes.

features.name: ring_system_indicator
features.description: Semantic judgment of whether the molecule contains complex ring systems, based on the combination of topological indices and fragment counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a categorical-like distance metric that forces KNN to group structurally similar ring systems together.

features.name: functional_group_diversity
features.description: Semantic judgment of the diversity of functional groups present, assessing the non-zero count of various fragment descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN identify neighborhoods with similar chemical reactivity profiles by summarizing sparse functional group indicators.

features.name: v39_v15_similarity
features.description: Computes an inverse-distance similarity score between V39 and V15.
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly feeds a bounded similarity metric into the KNN distance function, emphasizing instances where these two descriptors are closely aligned.

features.name: extreme_value_flag
features.description: Indicator if V12 or V30 deviate significantly from their respective training means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a hard cluster indicator, allowing KNN to isolate extreme outliers into distinct neighborhoods and preventing them from skewing normal distance calculations.

features.name: structural_compactness
features.description: Semantic judgment of the molecule's structural compactness, evaluating the ratio of surface area descriptors to volume or molecular weight proxies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a high-level geometric feature that complements raw distance metrics, improving the topological grouping of instances.
